answer_1.quote: We propose the first melody-constrained lyric revision framework ... to generate full-length, melody-aligned lyrics with high singability and prosody.

answer_2.quote: We use widely-adopted metrics like diversity, perplexity, and BERTScore to evaluate the generated lyrics, as well as a prominent word‑note matching rate.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a qualification task to select annotators with expertise in song and lyric annotation ... At least three workers annotated each song, rating the lyrics' quality on a 1-5 Likert scale across five categories.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated lyrics on criteria such as prosody, intelligibility, singability, coherence, and creativity.
